analysis.summaryJa: 名詞節は主語や動詞が必要とする「中身」を届ける。be動詞の後ろでは主語となるquestion・problemなどの内容を説明し、think・say・know・ask・rememberなどの後ろでは思考・発話・疑問の内容になる。適切な型では前置詞の後ろにもwh節を置ける。thatは平叙内容、whether/ifはyes/noの不確実性、whは具体情報を表す。
grammarPoints: be動詞の後ろの名詞節は主語の内容を説明する
thought・speech・knowledge・question動詞は目的語として内容節を取る
that節は事実・主張という平叙内容を表す
whether/if節は〜かどうかというyes/no内容を表す
wh節は具体的な不足情報を表し内部は平叙文語順
depends onなど適切な前置詞の後ろにwh名詞節を置ける
visualEvidence: beの後、思考発話疑問動詞の後、前置詞の後という三つのソケットが描かれる
THAT・WHETHER/IF・WHの三種類のラベルが情報タイプを示す
question is whether ...が主語の中身を説明する例としてある
Tell me where the station isが非倒置の正解として示される
commonTraps: 埋込み疑問で主語とbe動詞を倒置する
前置詞の後ろに完全な直接疑問文を置く
thinkやsayの内容節に不要な前置詞を挟む

questions.prompt: The main question is ------- the venue can accommodate 300 guests.

choices.A: what place

questions.translationJa: 主な問題は、その会場が300人を収容できるかどうかです。
questions.explanationJa: yes/noで答える不確実な内容をbeの後ろで説明するためwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: We believe ------- the revised process will reduce waiting times.

choices.A: that

questions.translationJa: 修正された手順で待ち時間が短縮されると考えています。
questions.explanationJa: believeの平叙内容をthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: Please tell me where the registration desk -------.

choices.A: is it

questions.translationJa: 登録受付がどこにあるか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込みwhere節では主語the deskの後ろにbe動詞isを置きます。

questions.prompt: The final cost depends on how many units we -------.

choices.A: do we order

questions.translationJa: 最終費用は当社が何台注文するかによります。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞onの目的語となるhow many節内部はwe orderの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Young asked ------- the replacement had already shipped.

choices.A: if

questions.translationJa: ヤングさんは交換品がすでに発送されたか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: askedのyes/no疑問内容をif節で表します。

questions.prompt: I remember when the branch ------- to this building.

choices.A: did move

questions.translationJa: 支店がいつこの建物へ移ったか覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: rememberの目的語となるwhen節内はthe branch movedの語順です。

questions.prompt: The fact is ------- no payment was recorded for this invoice.

choices.A: whether question

questions.translationJa: 事実は、この請求書への支払いが記録されていないことです。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した平叙内容をbeの後ろで示すためthat節を使います。

questions.prompt: The team is discussing ------- it should launch the update today or tomorrow.

choices.A: that fact

questions.translationJa: チームは更新を今日公開するか明日公開するか話し合っています。
questions.explanationJa: 二択の内容なのでwhether節をdiscussingの目的語にします。

questions.prompt: Our response will depend on what the customer ------- next.

choices.A: requests

questions.translationJa: 当社の対応は顧客が次に何を求めるかによります。
questions.explanationJa: what節内は単数主語customerに現在形requestsを用います。

questions.prompt: The report explains why the shipment ------- delayed.

choices.A: was it

questions.translationJa: 報告書には荷物がなぜ遅れたか説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: why節内はthe shipment was delayedという受動の通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence explaining the content of “problem.”

choices.A: The problem is that is the serial number missing.
choices.B: The problem that the serial number is missing it.
choices.C: The problem is what did the serial number miss.
choices.D: The problem is that the serial number is missing.

questions.translationJa: 問題はシリアル番号が欠けていることです。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞の後ろのthat節がproblemの具体的内容を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after “know.”

choices.A: We know where are the spare keys kept.
choices.B: We know where the spare keys are kept.
choices.C: We know where do they keep the spare keys.
choices.D: We know where the spare keys do kept.

questions.translationJa: 予備の鍵がどこに保管されているか知っています。
questions.explanationJa: knowの目的語となるwhere節は主語＋受動動詞の通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct yes-or-no content clause.

choices.A: The receptionist asked that the visitor had an appointment whether.
choices.B: The receptionist asked did the visitor have an appointment.
choices.C: The receptionist asked whether the visitor had an appointment.
choices.D: The receptionist asked what the visitor had an appointment.

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は来訪者に予約があるか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no内容はwhether＋主語＋動詞の名詞節にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after the preposition “on.”

choices.A: Delivery time depends on which route the driver takes.
choices.B: Delivery time depends on which route does the driver take.
choices.C: Delivery time depends which route the driver takes on.
choices.D: Delivery time depends on does the driver take which route.

questions.translationJa: 配送時間は運転手がどの経路を使うかによります。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞onの目的語にwhich route＋主語＋動詞のwh節を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct statement-content clause.

choices.A: Mr. Ortiz said whether the meeting had been postponed as a fact.
choices.B: Mr. Ortiz said that had the meeting been postponed.
choices.C: Mr. Ortiz said about that the meeting postponed.
choices.D: Mr. Ortiz said that the meeting had been postponed.

questions.translationJa: オルティスさんは会議が延期されたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: saidの平叙内容をthat節で示し、内部は通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct embedded question after “tell me.”

choices.A: Tell me how does the new scanner work.
choices.B: Tell me how the new scanner does works.
choices.C: Tell me how the new scanner works.
choices.D: Tell me does the new scanner work how.

questions.translationJa: 新しいスキャナーがどう動くか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: tell meの目的語となるhow節では主語scanner＋動詞worksの順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence explaining the content of “decision.”

choices.A: The decision is whether should we replace the server.
choices.B: The decision is whether we should replace the server.
choices.C: The decision whether we should replace the server is it.
choices.D: The decision is that whether we replace the server.

questions.translationJa: 決めるべきことは、サーバーを交換するかどうかです。
questions.explanationJa: beの後ろのwhether節がdecisionの二択内容を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct clause after “remember.”

choices.A: She remembers who did approve the request it.
choices.B: She remembers whom did approve the request.
choices.C: She remembers did who approve the request.
choices.D: She remembers who approved the request.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は誰が申請を承認したか覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: whoが節内の主語を兼ねるためwho approvedと続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with an “about” socket.

choices.A: We talked about what does the customer expect from the service.
choices.B: We talked what the customer expects about from the service.
choices.C: We talked about what the customer expects from the service.
choices.D: We talked about did the customer expect what.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは顧客がサービスに何を期待するか話し合いました。
questions.explanationJa: aboutの目的語にwhat＋主語＋動詞の名詞節を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence explaining a stated conclusion.

choices.A: The conclusion is that the original estimate was too low.
choices.B: The conclusion is whether the original estimate was too low as fact.
choices.C: The conclusion is that was the original estimate too low.
choices.D: The conclusion that the original estimate was too low it is.

questions.translationJa: 結論は元の見積額が低すぎたということです。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した平叙内容なのでbeの後ろにthat節を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The question is whether the room is available.”

choices.A: We need to know if the room is available.
choices.B: We know that the room is definitely available.
choices.D: Availability is unrelated to the room.

questions.translationJa: 問題はその部屋が利用可能かどうかです。
questions.explanationJa: whether節がquestionのyes/no内容を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I think that the lower bid is safer.”

choices.A: The lower bid thinks about safety.
choices.B: I do not have an opinion about either bid.
choices.C: In my opinion, choosing the lower bid involves less risk.
choices.D: I asked whether the lower bid exists.

questions.translationJa: 私は安い方の入札案がより安全だと思います。
questions.explanationJa: that節がthinkの判断内容を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I remember where we stored the samples.”

choices.A: The samples remember our storage room.
choices.B: I remember the location in which we stored the samples.
choices.C: I remember when the samples arrived.

questions.translationJa: サンプルを保管した場所を覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: where節がrememberの目的語となる場所情報です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Success depends on what we do next.”

choices.A: Success has no connection to our actions.
choices.B: Our next action will influence whether we succeed.
choices.C: We have already succeeded regardless of the next step.
choices.D: The next action depends on past success only.

questions.translationJa: 成功するかどうかは次の行動に左右されます。
questions.explanationJa: onの後ろのwhat節が成功を左右する行動内容を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The fact is that the fee was disclosed.”

choices.A: In fact, the fee was made known.
choices.B: The fee may or may not exist.
choices.D: The fee is a question without an answer.

questions.translationJa: 事実は料金が開示されていたことです。
questions.explanationJa: that節がfactの確定した平叙内容を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The buyer asked if delivery was included.”

choices.A: The buyer asked where the driver lived.
choices.B: The buyer wanted to know whether delivery formed part of the price.
choices.C: The buyer stated that delivery was free.
choices.D: Delivery was canceled without a question.

questions.translationJa: 購入者は配送が価格に含まれるか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: if節がincludedか否かというyes/no疑問内容を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our schedule depends on when the permit arrives.”

choices.A: The schedule determines whether a permit exists.
choices.B: The permit arrived after all scheduling ended.
choices.D: The permit’s arrival time determines our schedule.

questions.translationJa: 当社の日程は許可が届く時期で決まります。
questions.explanationJa: onの目的語となるwhen節が時期情報を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Tell us how the refund process works.”

choices.A: Tell us why no refunds are allowed.
choices.D: Explain the way the refund process operates.

questions.translationJa: 返金手続きの仕組みを説明してください。
questions.explanationJa: how節が手続きの方法・仕組みという具体情報を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The issue is whether we have enough staff.”

choices.A: Every employee has left the company.
choices.B: We need to determine if our staffing level is sufficient.
choices.C: The issue concerns only office equipment.
choices.D: We certainly have more staff than needed.

questions.translationJa: 問題は十分な人員がいるかどうかです。
questions.explanationJa: whether節が人員が十分か否かというissueの中身です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She knows who signed the form.”

choices.A: She knows the identity of the person who signed the form.
choices.D: She asks where the form is stored.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は誰が書類に署名したか知っています。
questions.explanationJa: who節が署名者という具体的な人物情報を表します。

questions.prompt: The sales forecast and the inventory report disagree. The question is ------- we should order more units.

choices.A: that fact

questions.translationJa: 販売予測と在庫報告が一致しません。追加注文すべきかどうかが問題です。
questions.explanationJa: 判断がyes/noの二択なのでquestionの中身にwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: The visitor cannot find the training room. Please tell her where it -------.

choices.A: is it

questions.translationJa: 来訪者が研修室を見つけられません。どこにあるか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込みwhere節では主語itの後ろにisを置きます。

questions.prompt: The supplier sent a written assurance. We believe ------- all replacement parts will arrive by Friday.

choices.A: that

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は書面で確約しました。交換部品はすべて金曜日までに届くと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: 確定的な判断内容をbelieveの後ろのthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: The final invoice changes with the number of attendees. It depends on how many people -------.

choices.A: do they register

questions.translationJa: 最終請求額は参加者数で変わり、何人登録するかによります。
questions.explanationJa: onの後ろのhow many節内はpeople registerの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: The customer did not recognize the charge. She asked ------- it came from a previous order.

choices.A: that certain

questions.translationJa: 顧客は請求に心当たりがなく、以前の注文分か尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/noの質問内容をaskedの後ろのif節で表します。

questions.prompt: The old office had a secure cabinet. I remember where the finance team ------- the backup key.

choices.A: did keep

questions.translationJa: 旧オフィスには安全な保管庫がありました。財務チームが予備鍵をどこに保管したか覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: rememberの目的語となるwhere節はthe team keptの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: The announcement confirms the closing date. The fact is ------- the branch will stop service on June 30.

choices.A: that

questions.translationJa: 発表で閉鎖日が確認されました。事実として支店は6月30日に営業を終了します。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した平叙内容をfactの後ろのthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: Two venues meet our budget. The committee is discussing ------- the downtown site offers enough parking.

choices.A: that fact only

questions.translationJa: 2会場が予算条件を満たしています。委員会は中心街の会場に十分な駐車場があるか検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: 検討中のyes/no内容なのでwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: The buyer may request either a refund or a replacement. Our next step depends on what she -------.

choices.A: does choose

questions.translationJa: 購入者は返金か交換を選べます。次の対応は彼女が何を選ぶかによります。
questions.explanationJa: what節内は単数主語sheにchoosesを用います。

questions.prompt: A maintenance log records the cause of every outage. It explains why the cooling system ------- yesterday.

choices.A: did stop

questions.translationJa: 保守記録には各停止の原因があり、冷却装置が昨日なぜ停止したか説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: why節内部は主語system＋過去動詞stoppedの通常語順です。
